metaData.title: We Open-Sourced MiniMax M3
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: MiniMax announces the open-sourcing of its flagship multimodal model M3 (428B total parameters / 23B activated parameters) and releases the MSA sparse attention paper. The model achieves leading results on multiple open-source leaderboards while continuously optimizing inference speed and deployment costs.
metaData.summary: This article is the official announcement from MiniMax regarding the open-sourcing of the M3 model. It first introduces the core technical features of M3: 428B total parameters, 23B activated parameters, making it the first open-source model to undergo multimodal mixed training from the pre-training stage. By leveraging large volumes of interleaved text, images, and other modality data, it achieves deep cross-modal semantic fusion. Concurrently, the MSA (MiniMax Sparse Attention) technical paper was released, detailing the architecture and engineering implementation to significantly reduce computational costs for long contexts. The article then showcases market feedback two weeks post-launch: achieving the highest ranking among open-source models on the Artificial Analysis Comprehensive Intelligence Index, ranking first among domestic models on the Vals.AI leaderboard, and citing positive feedback from industry figures such as the CEO of Vercel and the founder of Y Combinator. The article also addresses developers' primary concerns regarding service stability and cost, announcing that output speed has been increased from approximately 30 TPS to approximately 80 TPS, with plans for a further 30-40% improvement. Additionally, a Token Plan usage dashboard has been launched. Finally, the article elaborates on M3's design philosophy: ensuring high intelligence levels in complex reasoning, long-text, and multimodal scenarios while making it accessible and affordable for developers and enterprises.

mainPoints.point: M3 is the first open-source model to undergo multimodal mixed training from Step 0.
mainPoints.explanation: By using interleaved multimodal data such as text and images during the pre-training phase, it achieves deep cross-modal semantic space fusion, providing a foundational basis for subsequent multimodal understanding and generation tasks.

mainPoints.point: The MSA sparse attention architecture is the core technological breakthrough of M3.
mainPoints.explanation: The MSA architecture design significantly reduces computational costs for long contexts. The paper fully discloses the architectural and engineering implementation details, making it key to the model's high cost-effectiveness.

mainPoints.point: M3 achieves leading results on multiple authoritative open-source leaderboards.
mainPoints.explanation: It ranks first or on the Pareto optimal frontier among open-source models on benchmarks like the Artificial Analysis Comprehensive Intelligence Index, GDPval-AA, and Code Arena WebDev, with particularly strong performance in finance and coding tasks.

mainPoints.point: MiniMax continuously optimizes model service performance and costs.
mainPoints.explanation: Output speed has been increased from approximately 30 TPS to approximately 80 TPS, with plans for a further 30-40% improvement. A Token Plan usage dashboard has been launched to help users plan their usage and costs effectively.

keyQuotes: M3 is the first open-source model to do multimodal mixed training from Step 0.
While ensuring the model's intelligence is sufficient for complex reasoning, long-text, and multimodal scenarios, we truly achieve accessibility for developers, users, and enterprise customers.

relatedArticles.title: MiniMax Releases MMX-CLI: A Full-Modal Command Line Tool Designed for Agents
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: MiniMax has launched MMX-CLI, a command-line tool specifically designed for AI Agents, enabling native access to full-modal model capabilities through output isolation, semantic exit codes, and asynchronous control.

relatedArticles.title: MiniMax M3: Cutting-edge Coding, 1M Context, Native Multimodal — All in One Model
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: MiniMax releases the M3 model, integrating cutting-edge coding capabilities, 1M ultra-long context, and native multimodality, making it the first domestic model to combine these features, and it has been open-sourced.

relatedArticles.title: DeepSeek-V4 Preview: Ushering in the Era of Million-Token Context for Everyone
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: DeepSeek releases the V4 preview, offering Pro and Flash versions with million-token context as standard, achieving open-source leadership in Agent, reasoning, and knowledge capabilities, and open-sourcing the model simultaneously.

relatedArticles.title: MiniMax Agent Update: Redesigning How Agents Interact with Computers
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: MiniMax has released two major updates for its Agent desktop client: the Pocket feature enables remote computer control via IM, and the Computer Use feature allows the Agent to operate GUI software through visual recognition, with detailed explanations of the underlying technical implementation and design philosophy.

relatedArticles.title: AI R&D Automation: Wiki Knowledge Base + Skill Pack
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details how to build a continuously growing team knowledge base and a supporting expert skill pack based on the LLM-Wiki model and the Obsidian platform to achieve AI-driven R&D automation.

relatedArticles.title: MiniMax M2.7: Unlocking Model Self-Evolution
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: MiniMax releases the M2.7 model, featuring 'model self-evolution' capabilities and achieving significant breakthroughs in software engineering, professional office productivity, and multi-agent collaboration.

relatedArticles.title: One AI Is Not Enough
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: MiniMax introduces Mavis, a multi-agent collaboration system that uses a Leader-Worker-Verifier architecture and adversarial quality gates to solve the pain points of single agents in complex tasks, sharing its design philosophy, technical architecture, cost considerations, and applicable scenarios.

relatedArticles.title: 69. Interview with Yuandong Tian: The Real Problems of LLMs, Shifts, the AI Flood, and the Path Not Taken
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: A conversation with top AI scientist Yuandong Tian, exploring organizational challenges in the LLM race, research taste, fundamental breakthroughs in inference efficiency, and the evolution of the AI industry by 2026.

relatedArticles.title: LLM Training You Didn't Know: Principles, Paths, and New Practices - Tw93
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically outlines the full-stack architecture of LLM training in 2026, providing an in-depth analysis of key technical decisions and engineering practices ranging from pre-training, data engineering, and post-training to Agent training and Harness optimization.

relatedArticles.title: Kimi K2.6 Released and Open-Sourced, Significantly Advancing Code and Agent Cluster Capabilities
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Moonshot AI has released and open-sourced the Kimi K2.6 model, achieving significant improvements in code capabilities, long-horizon task execution, and Agent cluster collaboration, and announced the start of the Claw Group internal beta.
